codex.mycelialmind.entry.arsenal_defensa: Armor `[2, 5, 6, 2]` (Body **9**), Ench **14**, Tough **1.0F**, repaired with `chitin_plate`. Cuts infection duration **-20%** per piece.
• **`armor_rank` (`BASE` -> `MUTATED` -> `ELITE`):** upgrade to `MUTATED` with `synaptic_core` (self-repairs on mycelium/Tide) and to `ELITE` with `overmind_essence` or `tide_beacon`.
• **Elite Reflect & `trait_id`:** `ELITE` grants Absorption & reflects `1.25 * pieces` magic dmg; `trait_id` stores elemental affinity on armor, `genetic_sample`, and serums.
Swords, lances, launchers, grenades & field biotech tools

• `symbiotic_blade`: diamond-class symbiotic blade powered by a `hive_heart`.
• `enzyme_lance`: lightweight enzymatic lance engineered to cleave chitin.
• `neutralizing_spore_launcher` & `purifier_grenade`: neutralizing ranged suite; grenades force **5s** squad Desync and purge spores.
• `bio_extractor` -> extracts `genetic_sample`; `spore_antidote` / `concentrated_antidote` cure infection & rot; `chimera_ovum` hatches Chimeras.

• `purification_pylon` (`monument_focus`): blocks mycelium (`24m` default, `pylonPurificationRadius`), cures infection, blocks carrion, and smothers if **>=4** `antibody_cyst` cover its faces in Deep Mycelium.

• `purification_turret` (Tiers 1–3): auto-fires neutralizing spores; repairable with Antidote, Chitin, or Iron (cleanse if jammed **120t**).
• `purifier_drone_core` deploys Drones; `reinforced_bio_barrier` fortifies walls.

• **In mid-air:** purges **15.0%** Global Threat (**1200t / 60s** cooldown).
• **On `purification_pylon`:** overcharges and cleanses a **12m** radius (**400t / 20s**).

• `tide_beacon`: dispels an active Fungal Tide; rechargeable via amethyst and chitin (`tide_beacon_recharge`).
• `synaptic_suppressor`: locks global Hive adaptation (`120s` CD).
• `rift_catalyst`: ignites a `mycelial_rift` portal inside a valid `reinforced_bio_barrier` frame toward **Deep Mycelium** (`deep_mycelium`).

codex.mycelialmind.entry.fundamentos.ide: Philosophy & architecture of Mycelial Mind v2.0.0

**Mycelial Mind v2.0.0** (MC **1.21.1**, NeoForge **21.1.176**, Java **21**) replaces static difficulty with a persistent-memory hive (`HiveMindSavedData`).
Every damage stimulus (`StimulusType`) and tactical habit (`PlayerHabit`) recalibrates traits (`AdaptationTrait`), synergies, raids, and subterranean nodes.

Repeating one damage type fills its threshold (**70.0** at Tier 1 and effective **200.0** at Tier 2), hardening the swarm against that tactic.
Rotate melee, projectiles, fire, blasts, and magic; purge Nodes and craft countermeasures at the Synaptic Bench to bleed Hive memory.

codex.mycelialmind.entry.ia_tactica.camp: Trauma, Carrion, Ephemeral Chitin, Jams & Custom Goals
• **Trauma & Sappers (`LivingBattlefieldSystem`):** cells >=`0.55` trauma force infantry detours; only Sappers (`Burrower`, `ColonyWarden`, `ELITE`, or `BLAST_SHIELDED`) push straight through.
• **Anti-Pillar & Barricades (`ephemeral_chitin`):** pillaring **>=2 blocks** or sniping prompts temporary `ephemeral_chitin` ramps/barricades that crumble after **240t (12s)**.

• **Necrophagy (`NecrophagyGoal`):** non-boss kills leave carrion for **240t**: feeding heals **+6.0 HP** and grants **+20 XP** toward promotion. Fire damage or Pylon zones prevent carrion drops.
• **Jams:** `AcidSpit` jams turrets **120t (6s)** and `Leech` jams drones **80t (4s)**.
codex.mycelialmind.entry.ia_tactica.doct: • **Squad (`SwarmRole` / `CommandRole`):** assigns `FRONT_ANCHOR`, `FLANK_LEFT`, `FLANK_RIGHT`, `SUPPORT_REAR` under `LEADER` (`20m`). Enables predictive lead aim and casualty Frenzy.
• **Counter `Desync` (5s):** snipe the `LEADER` or detonate `purifier_grenade` to shatter command links (`SquadTacticalStatus`), zero out ballistic lead, and inflict `10.0` inaccuracy.

• **Pacing & Influence Map:** `HiveBlackboard` (`PacingPhase`) modulates assault intensity; `HiveInfluenceMap` tracks **512** cells (`0.35` diffusion, `0.01` prune) alongside max **24** `HiveHotspot` foci.
codex.mycelialmind.entry.memoria_colmena: • `false_engram_injector`: injects **+150.0** false stimulus for **90s** (`1800t`), forcing over-adaptation to one trait so off-type attacks deal **+25% bonus damage** (cooldown **60s** exposed / **20s** natural).

• `counter_serum`: bleeds the coded stimulus by `counterSerumBleedRatio` (**50%** default) to strip active adaptations.
• `synaptic_suppressor`: triggers global learning suppression (`suppressorCooldownSeconds = 120s`).
• **40/60 Split (`SynapticMemoryRouter`):** if a hostile Node lies within **48m** (`BUFFER_NODE_RANGE`), only **40%** enters global memory directly while **60%** stays in the node's volatile buffer.

• **Consolidation vs Purge:** after **600 ticks** (**30s**) the buffer commits globally. Shattering the Node earlier voids uncommitted data, drops `volatile_engram`, and bleeds `nodeDestructionStimulusBleed` (**18.0**).
• **MELEE -> `MELEE_THORNS`** (T1 >= **70**, T2 `flanking_swarm` >= **200**): punishes melee strikes with thorns and triggers pack flanking.
• **FIRE -> `FIRE_RESISTANT`** (T2 `pyro_surge`): thermal resilience and aggressive pyro-surge advances.
• **EXPLOSION -> `BLAST_SHIELDED`** (T2 `phalanx_breach`): raises base armor floor to **8.0** and speeds siege breaching (`Burrower` every **18t**).
• **MAGIC -> `MAGIC_CARAPACE`** (T2 `psychic_disrupt`): dampens magic/potion bursts and disrupts casters. Decay: **2.0/min** (x**1.75** in Tier 2).

• `COMBAT_MEDIC`: healing >=1.5 HP near Hive mobs (<16m) charges this habit; at >=**60.0** triggers `spore_rot`, cutting healing by **-30%** (`* 0.70F`).
• `HIGH_MOBILITY`: sustained kiting/sprinting provokes rapid flanking intercepts (`Stalker`, `SwarmFlankGoal`).
• `BASTION_BUILDER`: building walls, turrets, or bench tiers escalates sapper priority (`Burrower`, `SporeArchitect`, siege charges).
• `SHADOW_INFILTRATOR`: heavy stealth/crouching triggers synaptic sweep reveals. Vary tactics to let habit gauges cool down.
Compound evolutions unlocked when paired traits align
• `PYROLYTIC_SHELL` (`FIRE_RESISTANT` + `BLAST_SHIELDED`): pyrolytic shell discharging reactive flame pulses under sustained pressure.
• `VENOMOUS_COUNTER` (`MELEE_THORNS` + `MAGIC_CARAPACE`): inflicts toxic infection counters against melee and arcane strikes.
• `KINETIC_MIRROR` (`PROJECTILE_DEFLECT` + `MELEE_THORNS`): fires reflective acid shard fragments (`AcidSpitProjectile`) back at attackers.
• `ARCANE_ABSORPTION` (`MAGIC_CARAPACE` + `FIRE_RESISTANT`): dampens magic, potions, and fire while sustaining combat vitality.
• `SIEGE_JUGGERNAUT` (`BLAST_SHIELDED` + `PROJECTILE_DEFLECT`): grants **>=0.75** knockback resistance floor and turbo wall breaching (`18t`).
codex.mycelialmind.entry.mundo_dimension: • `mycelial_outbreak`: 9-tall fungus claw with strict 6-neighbor physical welding (zero floaters), `MIN_OUTBREAK_SPACING = 56` & `outbreak_sealed_vault`.
• `surface_hive`: mega-capsule (r=8, h=16), `MIN_HIVE_SPACING = 192`, `MIN_NODE_CLEARANCE = 64`, subterranean crypt, mezzanine gallery, conduits, and `surface_hive_cache`/`gallery`/`crypt` chests.

• **Acid Rain & `antibody_cyst`:** under open sky during `IMMUNE_RESPONSE`, acid rain deals `2.0` dmg. Cysts grow (cap `64`/chunk); covering **>=4 faces** (`SMOTHER_FACE_THRESHOLD`) smothers Pylons until harvested/sedated.

• **`matriarch_citadel` (`matriarch_citadel_piece`):** features `AMBER` & `CRIMSON` chapels (`citadel_*_chapel`), Royal Apse (`citadel_royal_crypt`), and persistent `spore_behemoth` + 2 `colony_warden` guardians.

• **`twisted_citadel` (`twisted_citadel_piece`, `architectural_accent`):** twisted architectural reflection in Deep Mycelium using `.nbt` templates (`spire_tower`, `gallery_hall`, `vault_bunker`) adapted to your block palette and proportions.
• **Dimension `mycelialmind:deep_mycelium`:** entered via `mycelial_rift` ignited by `rift_catalyst` inside a `reinforced_bio_barrier` frame. Syncs Overworld Act tiers.
• **3 Biomes:** `deep_mycelium_caverns`, `hive_heart_sanctum`, and `latent_spore_forest`, each with dedicated looping biome ambience & spore fog.
• **`WfcCavernLayout` (`Tile`):** Wave Function Collapse cavern layout solver preventing disconnected pockets.

codex.mycelialmind.entry.red_sinaptica.i: Node hijacking & 96m teleport transferring Chimeras & Drones
Apply `synaptic_graft` to a hostile node -> `symbiotic_node` (cap `maxSymbioticNodes = 4`). Recharge **+15%** using `mycelial_biomass`.

• **Link (`Shift + Right-Click`):** warps between `symbiotic_node`s within **96m** (`mycorrhizalTravelRange`, `16–256m`).
